tasks.label: ESP-IDF: OTE Upload over Ethernet
args: call C:\esp\v6.1\esp-idf\export.bat && idf.py build && python tools\ote_upload.py -i ${input:otaDeviceIp} -f build\ESP32TimeServer.bin --fingerprint ${input:otaFingerprint}
